headline: MIN @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.75 at CHW 4.05, with a projected total of 7.80. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: MIN moved -1.06 runs while CHW moved -0.40, changing the projected margin by -0.67 runs. The projected total fell -1.47, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +20.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Kendry Rojas has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Munetaka Murakami, Byron Buxton, Chase Meidroth, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags James Outman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
